sources.name: QKB — Qendra Kombëtare e Biznesit (National Business Center) commercial register

sources.name: e-Albania government services portal (company extracts)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED LIVE. Central e-gov portal; company register extracts delivered as e-services but LOGIN REQUIRED (Albanian eID). Not a crawl target; useful as the official extract channel.

sources.name: OpenCorporates Albania (AIS / Albanian Institute of Science)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED LIVE. Civil-society mirror of the business register: ~38.8k active companies, shareholders/ownership, status, profit figures, concession agreements. Browsable/parseable HTML. Best practical machine route into Albanian company data; respect robots.txt. Not affiliated with opencorporates.com.

sources.name: DPT — Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Tatimeve (tax administration) open data
sources.verdict: VERIFIED LIVE. Has an 'Open Data' section plus statistics/reports; taxpayer-level register lists not confirmed on homepage. Secondary confirmation source for active-entity status.

sources.name: ASHK — Agjencia Shtetërore e Kadastrës (State Cadastre)

sources.name: INSTAT — Albanian Institute of Statistics (business registers statistics)

sources.name: AMF — Autoriteti i Mbikëqyrjes Financiare (Financial Supervisory Authority) licensed-entities registers

sources.name: ASD — Agjencia e Sigurimit të Depozitave (Deposit Insurance Agency) member list

sources.name: ERE — Enti Rregullator i Energjisë (Energy Regulator) license registries

sources.name: AKF — Agjencia Kombëtare e Falimentimit (National Bankruptcy Agency) registers

searchedButAbsent: IMPORTANT METHOD CAVEAT: this session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before the task began, so discovery relied on prior domain knowledge plus ~25 direct WebFetch verifications; a follow-up web-search pass is advisable to catch anything newly launched. Genuinely ABSENT or NOT FOUND for Albania: (1) PE/VC association — none exists; no Invest Europe national association, no Albanian fund-managers association; the GP ecosystem is essentially regional (SEE funds, EBRD/AADF vehicles). (2) Crypto/MiCA/VASP public licensee register — Albania's fintech law 66/2020 created a licensing framework under AMF, but no operational public register of licensed VASPs was located. (3) Carbon registry — Albania is outside the EU ETS; no national carbon registry exists. (4) Valuer directory — no public RICS-style or national online roll of licensed property valuers located (licensing is ministerial, lists not found online). (5) Public lawyer roll — DHKA (bar) site verified but exposes no searchable advocate directory. (6) Stock exchange depth — ALSE is live but lists mostly government securities with extremely few corporate issuers; the older state-backed Tirana Stock Exchange closed (~2017) without ever trading listed equities, so 'issuer list' coverage is honest but near-empty. (7) Insurers association (Shoqata e Siguruesve) — believed to exist but no working URL verified. (8) Startup Albania agency / dedicated startup-media portal — not verified. (9) QKB bulk/open-data or API — none found; only annual/monthly statistics. (10) Machine access blockers: amf.gov.al, bankofalbania.org, ieka.al, ashk.gov.al, qbz.gov.al and most major news sites (panorama, politiko, top-channel, seenews, reporter.al, exit.al, businessmag.al) return 403 to non-browser clients; instat.gov.al and fint.gov.al refused connections; gjykata.gov.al returned 500 — all need browser-grade crawling or re-verification. Total honest count is ~50 entries only if one pads; the genuine catalog above is 49 entries of which ~30 were live-verified this session.
